title: Father and Son
description: In his workshop in Malta, Mario Pandolfino, a 76-year-old toymaker and inventor, poses with his son, Matthew, 41, an artist and set designer. Photographer Valery Poshtarov made this portrait as part of a series he calls Father and Son. He’s traveled to 15 countries, asking his subjects to hold hands, something they may not have done in decades. “I’m giving them this safe space,” he says, “to build or rebuild a connection.”
translated_description: 在马耳他的工作室里，76岁的玩具制造商兼发明家马里奥·潘多尔菲诺与41岁的儿子马修——一位艺术家兼布景设计师——一同合影。摄影师瓦莱里·波什塔罗夫拍摄了这张肖像，作为他名为《父与子》系列作品的一部分。他已走遍15个国家，请拍摄对象牵手，而这一举动他们可能几十年都未曾做过。“我给他们这个安全的空间，”他说，“去建立或重建一种联结。”
